mapper.sql: id, reservation_id, user_id, status, total_amount, currency, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( id, reservation_id, user_id, status, total_amount, currency, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{id}, reservation.id, reservation.user_id, 'PENDING', SUM(reservation_item.price), #{currency}, #{now}, #{now} FROM reservations reservation JOIN reservation_items reservation_item ON reservation_item.reservation_id = reservation.id WHERE reservation.id = #{reservationId} AND reservation.user_id = #{userId} AND reservation.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND reservation.expires_at > #{now} GROUP BY reservation.id, reservation.user_id ON CONFLICT (reservation_id) WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'PAID') DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE orders target SET status = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id = target.id) THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'CANCELLED' END, updated_at = #{now} WHERE target.id IN ( SELECT o.id FROM orders o JOIN reservations r ON r.id = o.reservation_id WHERE o.status = 'PENDING' AND r.status IN ('EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED', 'PAYMENT_FAILED') ORDER BY o.created_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED )
